在Croparia 4.5中，您可以通过添加一个json文件来添加自己的作物：.minecraft/crops/

json文件应如下所示：

 

FABRIC : 

{
"name":"示例",
"tier":1,
"tag":"c:raw_gold_ores",
"color":"0x4FD333"
}
 
 
 
FORGE :
{
"name":"示例",
"tier":1,
"tag":"forge:raw_materials/gold",
"color":"0x4FD333"
}
 
添加作物后，您需要在资源包中添加一些资产。
 
assets -> croparia -> blockstates -> block_crop_[作物名称].json

{
"variants": {
"age=0": {
"model": "croparia:block/crop_stage0"
},
"age=1": {
"model": "croparia:block/crop_stage1"
},
"age=2": {
"model": "croparia:block/crop_stage2"
},
"age=3": {
"model": "croparia:block/crop_stage3"
},
"age=4": {
"model": "croparia:block/crop_stage4"
},
"age=5": {
"model": "croparia:block/crop_stage5" 您可以将crop_stage5更改为：animal_stage5 / monster_stage5 / food_stage5 / nature_stage5
},
"age=6": {
"model": "croparia:block/crop_stage6" 您可以将crop_stage6更改为：animal_stage6 / monster_stage6 / food_stage6 / nature_stage6
},
"age=7": {
"model": "croparia:block/crop_stage7" 您可以将crop_stage7更改为：animal_stage7 / monster_stage7 / food_stage7 / nature_stage7
}
}
}

 

assets -> croparia -> models -> item -> seed_crop_[作物名称].json

assets -> croparia -> models -> item -> fruit_[作物名称].json

{
"parent": "minecraft:item/generated",
"textures": {
"layer0": "croparia:item/seed_crop"
}
}

{
"parent": "minecraft:item/generated",
"textures": {
"layer0": "croparia:item/fruit_crop",
"layer1": "croparia:item/fruit_crop_overlay"
}
}

 

assets -> croparia -> lang -> en_us.json

"block.croparia.block_crop_[作物名称]": "[作物名称] 种子",

"item.croparia.fruit_[作物名称]": "[作物名称] 果实"
